function: Learned actor picks the SIC decoding order and convex optimization sets power: NOMA resource allocation for weighted proportional fairness, none of the seven areas (pp. 1, 5).
notes: Excluded for function (Step 1, rule 5). arXiv v1 preprint, 20 pages read in full. The attention actor, trained with REINFORCE and a baseline network (p. 5), only generates the SIC decoding order; user powers come from a convex program (p. 7). The objective is weighted proportional fairness of rates (p. 1) and the paper lists its topic as resource allocation (p. 1, Index Terms), so no symbols are recovered and it is not area 1. Borderline for the reviewer: SIC ordering is a detection-order decision. The main model has single-antenna users and a scalar channel gain per user (pp. 3-4); a 2-antenna BS with MMSE equalization appears only as an extension (pp. 9, 15). A code link exists (pp. 1, 11), but items and criteria are left empty for an excluded work.
